name: EMA-x (NO z gate)
description: Recovered decision-system config: EMA cross + Vd + Z majority vote; NO z neutral gate; ticks guard; z_nan => Neutral. Intended for live dry-run (timeout/no wager).
truth_target: call15 (derived externally when backtesting); live uses next-epoch outcome unknown.

ema_ok.note: ema_ok = |ema_fast-ema_slow| > mad_k * MAD(diff) over rolling window

zscore.note: NO z gate. Z vote still used in majority.

vd.note: Vd = sign(VWAP(last 30s of tail) - VWAP(first 30s of tail)).

flip.definition: flip when (E and Z disagree) persists K epochs
flip.flip_mode_rule: if flip and ema_ok then follow Vd else majority

vote.tie_breaker: prefer Z if nonzero else E
